entries.text: Avoid — only affect F1/F2/F3 formation brace, which Orochi never uses.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Bottom Line (recommended) for consistent results — 2 ability has three quick attacks, can proc parry, has some block break, high minimum damage; Full Top Line is slower/less block but snowballs better in blob fights. Hero pairing: Chaindart, any lock-ult class. Key mechanics: 1->2 combo (use 1, right before the second strike use 2 to make it CCi for the rest of 1's duration, pull out and repeat) overcomes 2's weakness of not animating if CC'd/dazed; 1 phases through enemy units letting 2 maximize DPS inside the enemy blob; avoid blob fights when 1 is on CD and enemy has stun/daze; 2 can one-shot heroes with the bottom line's short cooldown. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Orochi Samurai is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).

entries.text: Block units, or units that can dodge damage.
Any units with high damage reduction — has one of the highest minimum damage values in the game, so it counters Spartan, Reapers, etc.
Hero pairing: Chaindart, any lock-ult class (per Amya).

steps.text: Use the 1 ability, and right before the second strike occurs, use 2 — this makes 2 CCi for the rest of 1's duration. Pull out and repeat.
1 phases through enemy units, letting 2 maximize DPS while inside the enemy blob.
If 1 is on cooldown and only 2 is up, engage only where the enemy lacks stun/daze; otherwise avoid blob fights.
2 can one-shot heroes even with a couple of models, with a short cooldown on the bottom line — use confidently in deathmatches.
